prompt: A young adult woman reclines slightly among soft cushions on a light greige fabric sofa. She has fair skin, large dark-brown eyes, shoulder-length softly wavy black hair, airy straight bangs, a tiny mole beneath one eye, and fresh natural makeup with soft coral lips. Her posture is relaxed as she looks directly up toward the elevated camera with closed lips and a calm, slightly serious expression. She wears light ivory workwear-style bib overalls with a low curved bib, broad straps, and clearly visible silver metal buckles, leaving her shoulders, neck, and collarbones exposed. One hand holds a smartphone with a pale lavender-blue case in the lower-left corner. The indoor background consists of the beige-gray sofa and cushions, with a softly blurred piece of wooden furniture in the upper-left area. Use a vertical approximately 3:4 composition and a close, slightly top-down half-body viewpoint, cropped from the top of the head to the waist; place her face near the upper center and let her body extend diagonally toward the lower right. Bright warm natural window light enters at an angle, casting dappled bands of light and shadow resembling window-frame or foliage patterns across her bangs, eyes, nose bridge, cheeks, collarbones, chest, and arms. Use a palette of ivory, warm beige, light gray, and natural skin tones contrasted by deep black hair. Render the fabric sofa, washed cotton overalls, and silver hardware with realistic fine texture. Photorealistic natural-light lifestyle portrait photography, precise focus on the eyes and face, detailed hair strands and natural skin texture, subtly blurred background, low grain, high detail, natural dynamic range, and a quiet, intimate afternoon atmosphere.
